farzi-cafe-kolkata.blurb: A modern Indian bistro at 13 Ho Chi Minh Sarani that applies molecular gastronomy to comfort food.

tips.expect: A lively, chic room with upbeat music. About ₹1,500 for two without alcohol and ₹2,000 with.
tips.good: The playful, modern take on North Indian dishes.
tips.watch: It is popular and loud on weekends.
tips.tip: Part of the Ho Chi Minh Sarani strip with Wafira, Cove and Mehico.

the-blue-poppy-thakali.blurb: A Sikkimese and Nepali restaurant at Sikkim Commercial House, 4/1 Middleton Street, helmed by Doma Wang, known as the 'Momo Queen' of India.
dishes: Thakali thali on a bell-metal plate

tips.expect: Floor seating on cushions behind a wooden jaali, or regular tables. Open 12 to 5 pm and 6:30 to 10:30 pm daily.
tips.good: The thali and the open momos, which are unusual in Kolkata.
tips.watch: Closed on the last Saturday of the month.
tips.tip: A good lunch before an evening on Park Street.

8th-day-caf-and-bakery.blurb: A cafe and bakery at Arcadia on AJC Bose Road, open about 9 am to 9 pm daily, with hand-crafted espresso drinks and an all-day breakfast.

tips.expect: A relaxed cafe and bakery with a strong breakfast menu.
tips.watch: It closes at 9 pm, so it is a daytime or early-evening stop.
tips.tip: A calm coffee stop on the way to Park Street.

mugs-and-shots.blurb: A small bar-cafe at 5A Sudder Street, seating about 35 to 40, serving beer, shots and bar bites.

tips.expect: A casual hangout with hookah and drinks. About ₹1,200 for two.
tips.tip: Next door to Raj's Spanish Cafe and Burger You.

wasabee.blurb: A casual Japanese, Thai and Asian restaurant at 175/A Motilal Nehru Road, about 550 m from Kalighat metro. Rated about 4.2.

tips.expect: A cheerful, informal place, open about 11 am to 11 pm daily.
tips.good: A big sushi menu at a relaxed price.
tips.tip: Convenient for the Kalighat pandal circuit.

aajisai-japanese-restaurant.blurb: A Japanese restaurant at Quest Mall, Ballygunge, with an automated sushi conveyor belt and a live teppanyaki counter.

tips.expect: An upscale, interactive Japanese meal. About ₹2,000 for two, reported open 12 to 9:30 pm.
tips.good: The conveyor belt and the live teppanyaki.
tips.watch: Mall hours and an early close, so it is not a late-night option.
tips.tip: Combine with The Irish House in the same mall for a drink afterwards.

the-burger-factory.blurb: A burger cafe on Park Street, opposite Mocambo, about ₹800 for two.

tips.expect: A wide burger and hot-dog menu in a casual space.
tips.tip: A quick bite on a Park Street crawl.

burgrill-park-street.blurb: A burger place opposite the Oxford Bookstore on Park Street, in the former Giggles location.

tips.tip: A fast, filling stop on Park Street.

steamin-mugs.blurb: A budget cafe at Gariahat Road South, Jodhpur Park, about ₹600 for two, known for mocktails.

tips.expect: A casual group spot with outdoor seating, open about 11 am to 10:30 pm.
tips.tip: A cheap meal after the Jadavpur pandals.

the-tavern-cafe.blurb: A popular Jodhpur Park cafe on Prince Anwar Shah Road with a rating of about 4.4 from over 700 reviews.

tips.tip: A good coffee stop near South City Mall.
